name: NEET PG
intro: NEET PG asks for a photograph, a signature and a left thumb impression, each under 80 KB. Signature and thumb are made inside a 3.5 × 1.5 cm box.

notes: Colour JPG under 80 KB, taken within the last 3 months.
Plain white background; full face, ears, neck and shoulders visible, face filling 70–80% of the frame.
documents.label: Photograph

notes: Sign inside a 3.5 × 1.5 cm box on plain white paper, in black or dark blue ink. Full signature, not initials.
documents.label: Signature

notes: Press your left thumb horizontally inside a 3.5 × 1.5 cm box with a fresh blue or black ink pad.
documents.label: Left thumb impression

source.label: Summary of NBEMS NEET PG 2026 image guidelines (news summary, check the NBEMS bulletin)

faqs.q: What is the NEET PG photo size?
faqs.a: A colour JPG under 80 KB with a plain white background, showing your full face, ears, neck and shoulders.

faqs.q: How do I make the NEET PG thumb impression?
faqs.a: Draw a 3.5 × 1.5 cm box on white paper, press your left thumb horizontally inside it, photograph or scan it, and choose the file here.
